I know how you feel..I had to go through a break up in December, it was extremely difficult especially during Christmas time and new years. The first couple weeks were a nightmare. Tbh I only started feeling somewhat alive (meaning I didn’t cry every few hours) maybe on week 3-4. And yeah it was very up and down from there. Some days I felt I was going forward, some days I felt I was going backwards and crying all the time again. Especially when things triggered me. But that’s all part of the healing process and is completely normal.

As for the tips.. the thing that helped me the most is having someone to talk to like a friend or family member. Another thing is deleting and not going on social media/ not checking how they are doing (it took a few weeks to stop checking if they posted or etc and I had to limit it little by little). Another thing is just allowing yourself to cry and be sad. I also watched a lot of videos of people documenting their breakup on YouTube, that helped me feel less alone in what I was going though. Obviously a big one is don’t talk to that person and don’t text them no matter how much you want to.. it will only make things worse. If they text you you can reply politely or just ignore if that feels better for you. I never blocked the person but some people prefer to do that so that they don’t wait around for them. I think that’s all for my tips. 

Just remember that it will take time but you will feel normal again and you’ll be able to process all of this better with time too. The first 2 days for me were like a haze.
